# opencode-file-editor [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/opencode-file-editor?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-file-editor) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/opencode-file-editor)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-file-editor) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/opencode-file-editor)](https://github.com/cheejiayuan512/opencode-file-editor/blob/main/LICENSE) [![CI](https://github.com/cheejiayuan512/opencode-file-editor/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/cheejiayuan512/opencode-file-editor/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/cheejiayuan512/opencode-file-editor?style=flat)](https://github.com/cheejiayuan512/opencode-file-editor/stargazers) A file editor panel for **OpenCode Desktop**. Files open in their own tabs, edits autosave, and writes never clobber what the agent just changed. Built on the `@opencode/plugin/gui` SDK, so it uses the app's own buttons, fields, tooltips, themes and Markdown renderer instead of its own widgets. Requires **OpenCode Desktop 2.2.5 or newer**. ## Preview The previews are rendered from docs/preview.html with sample data and follow your OpenCode theme. Sample files live in docs/samples — open them to try the panel. ## Features - **Tabs** — one per file, restored per session. `●` marks unsaved changes. - **Autosave** with `Ctrl/Cmd+S`, undo/redo, and drafts that survive tab switches. - **Conflict guard** — if a file changes on disk while it is open, autosave stops and asks **Reload** or **Overwrite**. It never silently overwrites. - **Atomic writes** — temp file then rename, so a crash cannot truncate a file. - **Byte-faithful** — CRLF and UTF-8 BOM are preserved. - **Markdown preview** rendered by the app's timeline renderer, with a Source toggle. Links inside a preview open in another tab. - **CSV/TSV table view** with row numbers and zebra rows (RFC 4180 quoted fields). - **Line numbers** that follow word wrap, plus wrap and auto-save toggles. - **Folder browser** — click any breadcrumb segment to browse, with folders and files colour-coded. One Browse tab, no tab per folder. - **Workspace tree** — the session workspace in a collapsible sidebar, loaded one folder at a time, with ignored files muted. It stays put while you switch tabs. - **Quick open** — type in the rail's filter for fuzzy paths; `Up`/`Down` moves the highlight and `Enter` opens it. - **Recent files** on the **Open file** tab. - **Reveal in file manager** and **copy relative path**. - Opens file links from chat in a tab instead of the read-only preview. ## Install ```sh opencode plugin add opencode-file-editor ``` Or add it to your global config so every window has it: ```jsonc // ~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc { "plugins": ["opencode-file-editor"] } ``` **`npm install` alone does not install the plugin.** It only downloads the files into the current project's `node_modules`, and OpenCode never looks there. Use `opencode plugin add`, or list the package in `plugins` as above — OpenCode then installs it under its own prefix and loads it. Restart OpenCode Desktop, then open the panel with `Ctrl+Shift+E` (`Cmd+Shift+E` on macOS), `/editor`, or **+ → File editor** in the session panel. ## Use - **Open a file** — click a file path in chat, type one in the panel (`src/App.tsx`, `C:\...`, `~/notes.md`, `../other/file.ts`), or pick from **Recent** / **Browse files**. - **Find a file** — expand the tree in the sidebar, or type in its filter to quick-open any path in the workspace. - **Navigate** — breadcrumb segments are buttons; each opens the folder. - **Save** — autosave after a pause; `Ctrl/Cmd+S` saves now. **Reload** re-reads from disk. `⋯` holds save, discard, reload, copy path, browse, reveal, settings. - **Markdown** — `.md`, `.markdown`, `.mdx` open rendered; toggle to source. - **Tables** — `.csv`, `.tsv` open as a table; first 500 rows, then a note. ## Limits - 2 MB per file; the panel is not a replacement for a large-file editor. - UTF-8 only. Invalid UTF-8 and binary files fall back to the app's preview. - Folder listings cap at 2,000 entries and show the real total. - The tree covers the session's workspace. A file outside it still opens through **Open file** or **Browse files**. - Quick open returns at most 200 results. - This editor only exists inside OpenCode Desktop (GUI plugins are desktop-only). - Everything runs locally: it reads and writes the files you point it at. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. ## Compatibility | opencode-file-editor | OpenCode Desktop | `@opencode/plugin` | |---|---|---| | 0.1.x | 2.2.x | ^2.2.5 | | 0.2.x | 2.2.5+ | ^2.2.5 | Tested against OpenCode Desktop 2.2.6. Each release checks the app's plugin-API major against the dependency before publishing, so a host upgrade fails the build instead of breaking users. ## Troubleshooting **Nothing opens when I click a file path.** Update to the latest version and restart OpenCode Desktop. If it still happens, open **Settings → Extensions → Plugins**, find the plugin and press **Reload**; a failed load is reported there. **The panel shows an error instead of a folder.** Restart OpenCode Desktop. The plugin's Ipc contract is registered for the life of the app, so a freshly updated plugin needs the app to reconnect. **Two editor tabs fight over the same file.** You have two copies installed. Remove either `~/.config/opencode/plugins/file-editor` or the npm package — both claim the id `file-editor`. ## Development ```sh npm install npm run build # gui-experimental.cjs at the package root npm test # builds, then runs every test npm run typecheck npm run verify:live # asks the running desktop app what it actually loaded ``` The package deliberately has **no `exports` map**. OpenCode resolves a plugin's parts by file name at the package root (`index.ts`, `gui-experimental.cjs`). A package `exports` entry makes it resolve `/gui-experimental` through `node_modules`, which cannot work for a directory you point at directly. The pure logic lives in `src/paths.ts`, `src/links.ts`, `src/tabs.ts`, `src/status.ts`, `src/view.ts`, `src/recent.ts`, `src/browse.ts`, `src/tree.ts` and `src/reveal.ts`; the filesystem is isolated in `src/fs-core.ts`; the UI is `src/gui.tsx`. To try a local checkout instead of the published package: ```jsonc { "plugins": ["/absolute/path/to/opencode-file-editor"] } ``` [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/cheejiayuan512/opencode-file-editor/blob/main/AGENTS.md) holds the test matrix, the rules the tests enforce and why each one exists, and the release procedure. ## Releasing Maintainer notes live in [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/cheejiayuan512/opencode-file-editor/blob/main/AGENTS.md). In short: bump `version`, add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, push a `v` tag — `.github/workflows/publish.yml` publishes over OIDC with provenance, no token and no one-time password. ## License [MIT](https://github.com/cheejiayuan512/opencode-file-editor/blob/main/LICENSE)

# Changelog

## 0.2.1

- README previews now show the workspace rail and quick open. The demo gained a
  quick-open frame, and `docs/preview.html` renders the tree so the screenshots
  can be regenerated.

## 0.2.0

- **Workspace tree** in a collapsible sidebar, beside every file tab. It reads
  the app's own file model: folders load as you open them, ignored files stay
  muted, and the rail survives tab switches.
- **Quick open**: type in the rail's filter for fuzzy path results, move with
  `Up`/`Down`, and press `Enter` to open. `Esc` clears the filter.
- The rail's width and open state are the app's shared panel sidebar, so they
  persist across restarts; drag its edge to resize.
- No new Ipc method: updating from 0.1.x needs no app restart.

## 0.1.6

- The **File editor** entry in the `+` menu now shows the panel instead of
  collapsing the side pane. The menu renders inside the pane, so the old
  `side.toggle` closed the region the click came from.
- `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+E` keeps toggling: it closes the panel only when the panel is
  on screen, and shows it when the region is showing Review, Browser or Terminal.

## 0.1.5

- Preview images and the demo GIF are cropped to the panel, with no empty canvas
  around them.

## 0.1.4

- README: animated demo covering the table view, source editor, Markdown preview
  and folder browser.
- Sample files to try the panel with (`docs/samples`): a CSV, a Markdown file and
  a TypeScript module.
- README: testing matrix and live-check output moved to `AGENTS.md`, so the
  package page stays focused on using the plugin.

## 0.1.3

- README rewritten for public readers: explicit requirement line, `Ctrl/Cmd`
  shortcuts, user-level troubleshooting, and absolute links so they resolve on
  npmjs.com as well as GitHub.
- Preview images regenerated with neutral paths (no personal username in the
  breadcrumbs).

## 0.1.2

- README: preview images for the table view, folder browser and source editor.
- The previews are generated from `docs/preview.html` with sample data.

## 0.1.1

- README: npm version, downloads, license, CI and stars badges.
- README: explain that `npm install` alone does not register the plugin.
- CI: OIDC publish workflow for `v*` tags (provenance, no token, no OTP).

## 0.1.0

First release for OpenCode Desktop.

- File editor panel with one tab per file, restored per session.
- Autosave, `Ctrl/Cmd+S`, undo/redo, and a draft that survives tab switches.
- Writes are atomic and guarded: a file changed on disk stops autosave and asks
  to **Reload** or **Overwrite** instead of clobbering it.
- BOM and CRLF are preserved; files over 2 MB or non-UTF-8 are refused.
- Markdown preview rendered by the app's own renderer, with a Source toggle.
- CSV/TSV table view with row numbers and zebra rows.
- Line-number gutter, word wrap, and auto-save toggles (wrap-aware numbers).
- Clickable breadcrumb and a folder browser to find files without leaving the
  panel; files and folders are colour-coded.
- Recent files on the **Open file** tab.
- `Reveal in file manager` and `Copy relative path`.
- Opens file links from chat in a new tab instead of the read-only preview.
